- Positioning statement
- Messaging hierarchy (tagline, value props, proof points)
- Voice & tone guide
- Naming recommendation (company, product, or campaign)
- Visual direction brief (mood, principles — not full identity)
- Brand guide PDF (final compiled artifact)
- Internal rollout deck (for team alignment)
- Customer-facing launch narrative

**Time blocks**
- 60-min kickoff workshop
- 45-min stakeholder interviews (founder, exec, customer)
- 90-min positioning workshop
- 60-min messaging working session
- 45-min mid-engagement review

**Access tiers**

- Weekly sync (1 standing call/week)

**Support levels**

- 2 revision rounds per deliverable

## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Depth** | Research and interview thoroughness | Light (3 interviews, secondary research) / Standard (6 interviews, light primary) / Deep (10 interviews, customer research, competitor teardowns) | Sprint pace blocked at Deep |
| **Breadth** | Brand-system scope | Verbal-only (positioning + messaging) / Verbal + Visual direction / Full system (verbal + visual + naming) | Naming requires Verbal + Visual minimum |
| **Pace** | Calendar duration | Sprint (2 weeks) / Standard (6 weeks) / Extended (10 weeks) | Sprint blocks Deep depth; Sprint blocks Full breadth |
| **Format** | Deliverable polish & usability | Working doc / Branded PDF guide / PDF + rollout deck + launch narrative | Agency-handoff use case requires PDF minimum |
| **Support** | Access + revisions | Async-only, 1 revision / Weekly sync, 2 revisions / Slack + unlimited revisions | Slack tier requires Standard or Extended pace |
| **Architecture** *(domain-specific)* | Brand-system complexity | Single brand / Parent + 1 sub-brand / Portfolio (parent + 2+ sub-brands) | Portfolio requires Deep depth and Extended pace |
| **Post-Engagement** *(domain-specific)* | Embed after delivery | None / 30-day office hours / 90-day monthly embed | 90-day embed requires Full breadth |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block**
- Sprint pace + Deep depth
- Sprint pace + Full breadth
- Naming add-on without Visual direction
- Slack support tier on Sprint pace
- Portfolio architecture on anything below Deep + Extended
- 90-day embed without Full breadth
- Agency-handoff format on Working-doc format level

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

| Tier | Configuration | Positioning | Price | Anchor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Lite — Positioning Sprint** | Light depth · Verbal-only · Sprint (2wk) · Branded PDF · Async + 1 revision · Single brand · No post-engagement | For early-stage founders who need clarity on *what they are* before spending on visual identity or a website | **$5,500** | ~37% of flagship; priced as the "stop-rebuilding-the-deck-every-week" entry point. Below the cost of a single bad hire onboarded against fuzzy positioning. |
| **Core — Brand Guide** *(flagship)* | Standard depth · Verbal + Visual · Standard (6wk) · PDF guide · Weekly sync + 2 revisions · Single brand · 30-day office hours | For funded startups and growing companies ready to lock in a brand foundation a team and downstream agency can execute against | **$15,000** | Holds your current price. Senior-strategist-only delivery at roughly half a typical agency brand engagement ($25–50K). Flagship — must remain the rational choice. |
| **Premium — Brand System + Embed** | Deep depth · Full system (incl. naming) · Extended (10wk) · PDF + rollout deck + launch narrative · Slack + unlimited revisions · Parent + sub-brand · 90-day embed | For companies launching a new category, naming a new product line, or aligning a parent + sub-brand architecture pre-funding-round or pre-launch | **$34,000** | Sits below the sum-of-parts (~$42K if BYO'd) and well below a consultancy retainer ($50K+) or agency naming engagement alone ($20–30K). |

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** $5,500 (Lite configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
- Depth: Light → Standard +$3,000 · Standard → Deep +$5,500
- Breadth: Verbal-only → +Visual +$3,500 · +Visual → Full (naming) +$6,000
- Pace: Sprint → Standard +$1,500 · Standard → Extended +$2,500
- Format: Working doc → PDF +$1,500 · PDF → PDF + deck + narrative +$3,000
- Support: Async → Weekly sync +$2,000 · Weekly → Slack/unlimited +$3,500
- Architecture: Single → Parent + 1 sub-brand +$4,500 · → Portfolio +$8,500
- Post-engagement: 30-day office hours +$1,800 · 90-day embed +$5,500

**Floor:** $5,500 (Lite base — anything below is a paid discovery call, not an engagement)

**Ceiling:** $28,000 — above this, auto-route to Premium flagship or custom-scope conversation

**Configurator must enforce:** all invalid combinations listed in Part 2.

**Flagship-protection rule:**
- BYO'ing to Core's configuration sums to ~$17,500 → Core flagship at $15K is the rational discount (~14% savings)
- BYO'ing to Premium's configuration sums to ~$42,300 → Premium flagship at $34K is the rational discount (~20% savings)
- Discounts widen as you move up, which is correct: it rewards commitment to the deeper engagements where your margin and impact are highest.

| **Support** | Revisions + post-delivery access | 1 pass / 2 passes / Unlimited 14-day / Unlimited + 30-day follow-up | Unlimited+follow-up requires Standard depth minimum |
| **Format** | Visual treatment | ATS-safe only / ATS + designed PDF / ATS + designed + creative variant | Creative variant only for design/marketing/creative roles |
| **Add-ons** | À la carte | Cover letter / Interview talking points / 60-day refresh / Bullet-bank credits | — |

- Emergency (24-hr) + Deep depth

- Rush (3-day) + Multi-variant targeting

- Multi-variant targeting without Standard depth or higher
- Unlimited + 30-day follow-up without Standard depth or higher

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base price:** Lite (Free / MIT) — always the floor.

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing (tokens until niche named):**
- Depth: Core → Core+packs `+$d1` · → Core+packs+co-pilot `+$d2`
- Breadth: +1 vertical pack `+$b1` each · All-verticals `+$b2`
- Pace: Scheduled GHA `+$p1` · Continuous `+$p2`
- Format: +JSON/YAML `+$f1` · +Notion/Airtable `+$f2`
- Support: Async 48hr `+$s1` · Office hours `+$s2` · 1:1 Loom `+$s3` · Live co-pilot `+$s4`
- Distribution: Team `+$ds1` · Agency white-label `+$ds2` · Platform-embed `+$ds3`
- Branding: Co-branded `+$br1` · Full white-label `+$br2`
- Memory: Hosted shared `+$m1`

**Floor:** Free (Lite). Any paid configuration must include at least one of: Depth upgrade, Distribution > Solo, or Support > Community. Otherwise the user belongs on Lite.

**Ceiling:** Any BYO config that includes Distribution: Agency white-label **or** Platform-embed **or** Memory: Hosted **or** Support: Live co-pilot auto-routes to Premium (or to custom-quote if combining Platform-embed with custom verticals).

**Dependencies the configurator must enforce:** (see Part 2 invalid combos) plus:
- Selecting 3+ vertical packs auto-suggests All-verticals
- Selecting Continuous pace forces Memory ≥ claude-mem
- Selecting any white-label forces Distribution ≥ Agency

**Flagship-protection rule:**
- BYO sum to reach Core's config must exceed Core's flagship price (e.g., `d1 + b1×2 + p1 + f1 + s1 + s2 + ds1 + br1 > $B`).
- BYO sum to reach Premium's config must exceed Premium's price by a wider margin (license customers should always feel the bundle is the rational discount).
- Lite is free and cannot be undercut — its protection is structural: any value at all requires crossing the floor.
